column1: # Shopkeeper v1 voice manifest — drives tools/make_voice.py.
# One row per spoken line. make_voice.py renders each through Kokoro-FastAPI on
# the Mac and writes <slug>.ogg into game/assets/voice/. The slug names are what
# scripts/audio.gd asks for (see docs/DESIGN.md "Asset naming contract"):
#   order_<item>  — the customer asking for that item
#   thanks        — the shared thank-you after a correct delivery
# Optional per-customer variants (one voice per character
# `voice` is a Kokoro voice id (e.g. af_heart
# character on the Mac. `speed` is 0.5..2.0. Lines are short
